text_block_list.text:
One day, with only a few days remaining 
until 
the Milers Cup—

text_block_list.name: Street TV
text_block_list.text:
And so, today we bring you a special 
feature 
on the talk of the town: 
Special Week and her peers!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Resident A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Spe. Man, I really like her— 
she's got that real main character vibe, 
y'know?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Resident B
text_block_list.text:
I know, right! But I've got high hopes for 
King Halo! 
She's always giving it everything she's 
got in pursuit of glory... 
It really makes you want to root for her!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(As expected, the Classic generation makes 
a huge splash. 
I hear crowds at the racetracks have grown 
significantly 
larger because of them.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: And yet—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Back in December, my Trainer and I 
decided our course. 
To become a peerless blossom of this era, 
just like Brian— 
for now, I run the Tiara route.)

"That's why I don't think you need to 
rush."

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(That is what my Trainer told me. 
How could I ever doubt those words?)

text_block_list.name: Street TV
text_block_list.text:
—And just like that, they are enjoying 
massive popularity right now!

text_block_list.name: Street TV
text_block_list.text:
Which is why the number of young horse 
girls who idolize 
these stars is skyrocketing! More and more 
of them 
are setting their sights on Tracen 
Academy!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(...Horse girls who aspire to follow 
them...)

text_block_list.name: Young Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
I wanna be just like Grass-chan! 
'Cause she's so super cool! I'm gonna go 
hiyaaa and win first place in my races 
too!

text_block_list.name: Young Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, me too! I'm definitely, totally 
gonna be a horse girl just like Spe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(...The next generation is captivated by 
the dazzling light. 
It is toward the brightest stars that they 
yearn and reach out.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...No. 
Even so... we are...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Not mistaken.
And so came the morning of the Milers Cup.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(It is barely dawn, yet I find myself 
awake once more.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Just as I did on the day of my debut 
race, 
waking before the sun had even risen—)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Circumstances are... somewhat different 
from days gone by. 
Perhaps this feeling... is not 
exhilaration.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Shall I go bask in the dawn once more?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(The exhaustion from dedicating body and 
soul to the Tiara 
is completely gone. The Milers Cup... 
Together, we will surely claim victory.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, I shall take the crown in hand. 
I have the pride and confidence to do so, 
and yet...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —What is this restlessness within me?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...I will make the Club a beautiful 
garden. 
And for that, I must win the Milers Cup.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I will continue on. I will run the Tiara. 
And beyond that lies the future—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: (Why, then—do I not fully believe it?)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ............Haaaaaaah.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Focus!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Do not waver. There is no time for that. 
The race is today.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Do not display such unseemliness before 
your disciple, 
Phalaenopsis.

Before running the Milers Cup. As always, 
she was quietly meditating. 
And yet...

She didn't appear flustered. If asked what 
was specifically different... it was 
merely an intuitive feeling 
born from all the time we had spent 
together—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Do I appear nervous to you?
choice_data_list: Guess not... Sorry. Just forget I asked.

Guess not... Sorry. You can just forget I 
said anything.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Worry not, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I would not call my state 
perfection. 
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: , I am a blossom cultivated by your hands.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Even should my limbs tear asunder, 
I shall bring home a result worthy of 
pride.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Bear witness.
